maddeler.e:
افتضخا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَخَا (iftaḍaḵā) /if.ta.dˤa.xaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اُفْتُضِخَا (uftuḍiḵā) /uf.tu.dˤi.xaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
# اِفْتَضِخَا (iftaḍiḵā) /if.ta.dˤi.xaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَضَخَ (iftaḍaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
